title: Held-Position First Peer-Exit State Audit
question: For a position that remains open, does the first other-component exit being a stop or an ordinary native close define a broad held-position state that materially separates its eventual 2x-cost stressed R and stop incidence from positions that experience no peer exit before their own close?
hypothesis: A peer stop may reveal a shared adverse state while a peer native close may release a different portfolio phase. Either event is management-relevant only if the already-held position's eventual economics separate materially and broadly from otherwise same-strategy, same-period lifecycles that see no peer exit while held.
why_now: Unit 051 found material attrition at evidence, economic and translation layers and closed without prescribing one lane. After five intervening units since the last Program 4 allocation, the whole-map comparison now favors a clean tracked held-position observable that requires no RC4 repair, mark observer, holding threshold, book allocation or execution work.

variants.definition: The first exact-time batch containing another active component's exit while the target remains open contains only EXTERNAL_CLOSE stop exits.
The first exact-time batch containing another active component's exit while the target remains open contains only ordinary CLOSE exits.

distinction_from_closed_work.entry_time_crowding_017: Unit 017 observed incumbents at a new birth and judged that new lifecycle. Unit 052 begins after the target birth and observes the first peer exit while that target remains held.
distinction_from_closed_work.same_strategy_outcome_memory_023: Unit 023 used the preceding completed outcome of the same strategy before a later birth. Unit 052 uses a contemporaneous other-component exit during the target's active life.
distinction_from_closed_work.portfolio_exit_coordination: That family changed all-green cohort exits. Unit 052 changes no close and requires no floating-profit mark, peak, trail or cohort action.
distinction_from_closed_work.one_hour_adverse_exit_040: Unit 040 tested fixed age-plus-mark exit thresholds and closed invalid. Unit 052 uses no elapsed threshold or mark and does not repair or rerun that family.
distinction_from_closed_work.rc4_resolution_046: Unit 046 audited an RC4-specific checkpoint and closed invalid. Unit 052 uses exact full component identities across all six strategies and no RC4 telemetry.
distinction_from_closed_work.natural_book_complementarity_050: Unit 050 studied aggregate US30/US100 maximum drawdown intervals. Unit 052 uses no natural-book partition or drawdown episode; its state is the first causal peer exit while one position remains open.

causal_limit: Longer-held positions have more opportunity to observe a peer exit. Unit 052 asks whether the event-defined state carries information, not whether peer exit type causes the final outcome. No age matching, duration residualization or threshold rescue is permitted.

immutable_portfolio_inputs.economic_identity: exact frozen CP2 observation-equivalent shared portfolio control

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only exact component identity, OPEN/PASSIVE_PLACE/PASSIVE_FILL/PASSIVE_EXPIRE/CLOSE/EXTERNAL_CLOSE event type, server_time, sequence and fresh period were used. No close value, planned risk, target final stop association, stressed R, centered effect, gate or verdict was accessed.

fixed_role_assignment.event_order: Within each fresh period group rows by exact parsed server_time. For lifecycle integrity, use numeric state_sequence, close-before-birth precedence, source path and source line. Peer-exit role assignment treats all valid exits at one exact server_time as one simultaneous batch.
fixed_role_assignment.target_must_remain_held: A target closing in the same exact-time batch is not assigned a peer-exit role from that batch. Only targets active before and remaining active after the batch are eligible.
fixed_role_assignment.new_birth_exclusion: OPEN and PASSIVE_FILL at the same exact server_time occur after the peer-exit batch for role assignment and are not exposed to that batch.
fixed_role_assignment.first_batch_only: The first eligible peer-exit batch permanently assigns the target role; every later peer exit is ignored.
fixed_role_assignment.PEER_STOP_FIRST: Every peer exit in the first eligible batch is EXTERNAL_CLOSE.
fixed_role_assignment.PEER_NATIVE_CLOSE_FIRST: Every peer exit in the first eligible batch is ordinary CLOSE.
fixed_role_assignment.MIXED_SAME_TIME_FIRST_PEER_EXIT: The first eligible batch contains both CLOSE and EXTERNAL_CLOSE. Context only and cannot pass or rescue a variant.
fixed_role_assignment.NO_PEER_EXIT_WHILE_HELD: The target reaches its own close without an earlier eligible peer-exit batch.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.exact_component_selection: Use only the six complete component_id keys in strategy_identity. Prefix, suffix, substring, wildcard and inferred-family selectors are prohibited.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return and supplies positive planned risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_pending: PASSIVE_PLACE stores positive planned risk; PASSIVE_EXPIRE clears it and PASSIVE_FILL begins Passive with the active risk.
fixed_reconstruction.target_close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the target lifecycle; value_b is 2x-cost stressed net USD and target EXTERNAL_CLOSE is its stop outcome.
fixed_reconstruction.stressed_r: Target close value_b divided by positive birth planned risk.
fixed_reconstruction.strategy_period_centering: Within each of the 24 complete strategy x fresh-period cells, subtract the full-cell mean stressed R and full-cell stop rate from each lifecycle before role aggregation.
fixed_reconstruction.variant_effect: Variant mean centered metric minus NO_PEER_EXIT_WHILE_HELD mean centered metric.

fixed_metrics.role_context: Report raw count, stressed R, stop incidence, birth-to-close duration and birth-to-first-peer-exit duration for context without duration adjustment.
fixed_metrics.variant_contrast: For each variant report pooled centered R and stop differences, four period effects and six strategy effects.
fixed_metrics.period_contribution_share: Absolute period contribution to pooled centered-R contrast divided by summed absolute contributions across four periods.
fixed_metrics.strategy_contribution_share: Absolute strategy contribution to pooled centered-R contrast divided by summed absolute contributions across six strategies.

fixed_integrity_gate: All six files retain their listed bytes and hashes and contain 16,477 rows with zero exact duplicate full rows.
Reconstruct exactly 2,233 lifecycles with strategy totals 272/206/805/118/238/594, 407.0477 USD stressed net and 206 target stop exits with zero overlap, pending, risk or close fault.
Reproduce exact pooled, period and strategy role counts and zero mixed same-time role.
Every lifecycle receives exactly one role and one finite target outcome; no target is exposed to a peer batch at its own close time or before its birth.
Reconstruct exactly 24 finite strategy-period centering cells.

density: Variant and comparator each contain at least 100 pooled lifecycles.
Variant contains at least 20 and comparator at least 100 lifecycles in every period.
Variant contains at least 10 and comparator at least 25 lifecycles in every strategy.
Variant is present in at least 20 of 24 strategy-period cells and comparator in all 24.
information: Absolute variant-minus-comparator centered stressed-R difference is at least 0.10R.
Absolute variant-minus-comparator centered stop difference is at least 0.05.
Pooled channels are economically concordant: positive R requires negative stop difference and negative R requires positive stop difference.
Return and stop differences each share their pooled sign in at least three of four periods.
Return and stop differences each share their pooled sign in at least four of six strategies.
No one period contributes more than 60% and no one strategy more than 45% of the absolute centered-R contrast.
fixed_variant_gates.pass_rule: A variant passes only if every density and information requirement passes. Zero is never counted as a sign.

fixed_bundle_gate.authority_limit: Consumed-data association only. A pass selects no close, hold, stop, trail, peer action, lot, slot, priority, EA or Live rule.
fixed_bundle_gate.retained_question_rule: At most one passing variant may retain one later independently declared all-six-strategy management-observer question, selected by larger absolute centered R then stop effect. It cannot open automatically.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration before reading target close values or calculating stressed R, target stop association, durations, centered effects, gates or verdict.
Run exactly one fixed in-memory aggregation over the six frozen files with exact-time peer-exit batches and complete component identities.
Do not add second/last peer exits, elapsed windows, same/cross book, peer identity, peer count, direction, strategy or symbol subgroup, duration matching, mark state or entry crowding.
Do not repair Units 040 or 046, change an entry or exit, modify MQL, compile, run MetaTrader, inspect Program 6, retain a CLI, query broker/account state or touch Live.
Close after one result and return to whole-map comparison without adjacent Program 4 peer-exit work.
